core_obligations: Reduce abelianness to stalks: by the characterisation of abelian categories it suffices that image and coimage agree, and by the criterion for sheaves it is enough that they have the same stalk at every point (proof lines 382-385)

Identify the stalks: by the constructions of kernels and cokernels recalled earlier the stalk of the image and the stalk of the coimage are the image and coimage in the category of modules over the local ring (proof lines 386-387)
Conclude: the category of modules over a ring is abelian, so those agree, and the exactness criterion follows from the same description (proof lines 388-389)
proof_roadmap: 由「abelian ⇔ image 与 coimage 相等」的刻画，只需比较二者的茎；由层的点判据，这等价于逐点比较。
由前述核与余核的构造，image 与 coimage 的茎正是 O_{X,x}-模范畴中的 image 与 coimage，而后者相等（环上模范畴 abelian），故 Mod(O_X) 是 abelian；正合性判据同样化为逐点检查。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records that the category of modules on a ringed space is abelian and that exactness of a complex of modules can be checked on the stalks (author lemma at source lines 365-379, label lemma-abelian). The proof (source lines 381-390) reduces abelianness to the agreement of image and coimage, checks that agreement on stalks through the criterion for sheaves, and identifies the stalks of image and coimage with the corresponding objects of the category of modules over the local ring, which is abelian (proof lines 382-389). The reduction to stalks is the content. H2.
